description: key-hierarchy design §2–§4 (KH1): fixed vault epoch keys → identity seed → vault identity and recipient → §2.2 derived keys → link public keys; the root fingerprint of epoch 1; an epochLink from epoch 1 into epoch 2 (both signatures must verify); device and recovery fingerprints; listMessage and listTag of an epoch-2 list (lp() fields); wraps of K_2 to a fixed device key, made by two implementations; the three author signatures (addSig, epochSig, authorSig) by a fixed signing pair, made by noble and swift-crypto; join codes. Built to the merged design (#61); the encodings it leaves open are format.md §15.1.
